title: PRD Frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a Product Requirements Document. Mirrors docs/adrs/adr.schema.json to keep PRD and ADR governance lifecycles identical.

id.description: 3-digit zero-padded PRD identifier, e.g. "001". Must match the filename prefix.

title.description: Short, descriptive name of the feature.

date.description: Date of the initial draft, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

author.description: Role or name of the person who authored this PRD, e.g. "architect", "developer".

superseded_by.description: ID of the PRD that supersedes this one, or null. Required only when status is "superseded".

linked_adrs.description: List of ADR file paths, e.g. ["docs/adrs/001-choice-of-state-management.md"].

linked_research.description: List of research document paths, e.g. ["docs/research/001-auth-providers.md"].
